name: Grade 7 IT Practice: March Week 4 - Robot Systems
description: Practice words for robots as systems and debugging.

words.example: The robot system used sensors, motors, and code together.

words.definition: Information that goes into a system or program.
words.example: The button press was input for the robot program.

words.definition: The steps a system or program uses.
words.example: The process checked the command and chose a movement.

words.definition: What a system or program produces.
words.example: The motor movement was the output from the robot.
The sequence moved forward, turned, and stopped.

words.definition: To find and fix a problem in code.
words.example: The team debugged the code when the robot turned too far.
